facts.fact: In July 2016 the education ministry launched SIGE, whose first phase puts library, statistics, secretariat, desk and parts of finance in one database, with a single enrolment that pupils only confirm each year; pupils and parents are to see marks online.
SIGE was launched by the Ministry of Education, Science and Culture, and the minister explained it at the ceremony.

systems.owner: Ministry of Education, Science and Culture
systems.tiers: schools: library, statistics, secretariat, desks, parts of finance; pupils and parents via web
